vibe: Premium, trustworthy, distinctive 'Old Money Tech'. Grounded, secure, matte, physical.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy with Control Room Grid for dense data. Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards to prevent collision.

components.sidebar: Collapsible left-sidebar. Background #F3F3F1. Active state has 2px left border with #1A362D and #E6E5E1 background. Use Phosphor Icons.
components.cards: Flat background (bg-white), 1px subtle border (border-[#E6E5E1]), shadow-card. Hover: -translate-y-[2px], border darkens slightly.
components.tables: Dense but clear. IBM Plex Sans for body, IBM Plex Mono for numeric columns (right-aligned). No vertical borders. 1px bottom border on rows.
components.kpi_cards: Top-left 'North Star' layout. Value in Outfit. Use standard red/green for up/down, but muted (e.g., text-[#B94A48] or text-[#3C6E47]).
components.charts: Recharts. Line charts for portfolio performance with strokeWidth 2, no dots unless hovered. Donut charts for asset allocation. Golden rule: no hover required to see main trends.
components.auth_pages: Split screen layout. Left side: Form with minimal styling, pure white background. Right side: Full bleed image of abstract sand dunes (use provided media URL).
components.empty_states: Minimalist. Avoid generic illustrations. Use a single, large Phosphor icon (light weight) in #9D9C96, plus a clear call-to-action button.
components.buttons: Primary: bg-[#1A362D] text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-[#2C4F44]. Secondary: bg-white border border-[#E6E5E1] text-[#1C1C19] hover:bg-[#F9F9F8]. Add transition-transform active:scale-95.

motion.charts: Smooth drawing animation for line charts on mount.

media_urls.description: Abstract ripples of sand dunes under sunlight. Use for the right half of the split-screen login/signup page. Add a subtle bg-black/10 overlay.

testing.requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (kebab-case, role-based).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML + Tailwind CSS for main layouts and bento grids. Use Shadcn components for complex interactions (Dialogs, Dropdowns) and heavily customize them.
Use Recharts for all data visualizations. Map the colors provided in the 'colors.charts' array.
Implement the UI with a mobile-first approach, ensuring the sidebar collapses to a hamburger menu on small screens.
For the Auth pages, use the image URL provided in media_urls for a premium split-screen design.
Use @phosphor-icons/react for all icons to achieve a high-end, sophisticated look.
Never use pure black or grey. Use the tinted hex codes from the 'colors' object.
Ensure all numbers, metrics, and data tables use the monospace 'IBM Plex Mono' font for proper alignment.
